column1: # Capabilities the vendor's YouTube courses teach, and whether Cut Craft has them.
# Read by scripts/courses-report.py, which writes docs/courses.md. Tab-separated columns:
#   key, capability, status (yes / partly / no / out), Cut Craft evidence or what is missing,
#   title pattern (a video whose title matches teaches it), transcript pattern (a video whose
#   captions match it uses it), GitHub issue for a gap. Patterns are Python
# "out" = out of scope: laser, the vendor's online services and file formats, its Lua gadget API.
